$comment: Sun and moon shadows by cascaded shadow maps (docs/DAY_NIGHT.md §10): the second layer of the lighting, over the flood-fill sky and block light. Near the eye the shadow map shades the direct sun or moon term only; beyond the last cascade it fades to the first layer's stand-in (direct light × sky light). Run `node shared/look/shadows.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-look/src/shadows.gen.rs is stale.

cascades.$comment: nearM: where the first cascade's range starts (the log split's near; distances from the eye). Every cascade is a box around the eye (ADR 0047: it doesn't change as the camera turns, so a far cascade's map is kept between redraws). radiusStepM: each box's half-size is rounded up to a multiple of this, so a changing distance (the spyglass) changes it in steps. casterReachM: how far toward the light from a box a caster still casts into it (a cliff or a tree well above the view). edgeFade: shadows fade to the stand-in over this last share of the shadow distance. spyglassMaxM: while the spyglass zooms, the shadow distance grows with the magnification, up to this. slack: a far cascade's box is wider than the distance it covers by this share of it, and its map is kept while the eye stays within that margin. lightTurnDeg: a kept map is drawn again once the light has turned this far from where it was drawn.

bias.$comment: Against acne and peter-panning on ½ m steps and ramps. normalOffsetTexels: the receiver's lookup moves this many of its cascade's texels out along its normal. depthBiasM: the compare's constant bias (m along the light). slopeScale: the casters' slope-scaled depth bias (the pipeline's, per unit of depth slope).

lights.$comment: The time of day: a light's shadows fade in as it rises over the viewer's face's horizon, from fadeStartDeg to fadeEndDeg of elevation, to `strength` (1: the direct term wholly shaded). The sun casts while it is over the horizon, else the moon; none when neither is up.

tiers.$comment: Per Shadows setting (Off draws none). cascades: how many (1–4). resolution: each cascade's map (texels a side). distanceM: the shadow distance (from the eye). splitLambda: the cascades' distances, 0 even to 1 logarithmic. filterTexels: the soft PCF's radius (texels). filterTaps: its taps a side (each a 2×2 hardware compare). The nearest cascade is drawn every frame; a far one is kept until the eye leaves its slack, the light turns lightTurnDeg, or the casters in it change, and at most farPerFrame far cascades are drawn again in a frame (the most urgent first). refreshFrames: a far cascade with moving casters in it (other players) is drawn again at most once every this many frames. plantCascades: how many of the nearest cascades plants cast into (their alpha-tested blades cost the most per texel; beyond those cascades a plant's shadow is too small to see).
